== Notes ==
*This skill is part of the [[Agent of the Mad King]] disguise [[skill bar]].
*This skill makes all foes in spirit range into temporary [[Ally|allies]].
*When using this skill the character shouts: ''"The Mad King demands you let me pass with impunity!"''
*While affected by this skill:
**Foes that are now allies do not [[body block]] you. This can be handy to get out of swarming groups of [[Smite Crawler]]s.
**[[Dying Nightmare]]s will use [[Blood is Power]] on you when you are out of [[energy]].
**[[Obsidian Behemoth]]s' traps and Smite Crawlers' [[Zealot's Fire]] will still deal damage to you if the traps and Zealot's Fire finished [[Activation time|activating]] before you activated this skill.
**[[Coldfire Night]]s' [[Ward Against Harm]] and Obsidian Behemoths' [[Healing Spring]] will only affect you if those skills finished activating after you activated this skill.
